dependencies.required_evidence: The adjacent static layout review rederives 130 tensors, 17,802,103 logical bytes, 4,401 leaves, and a fail-closed open external partition.

cost_rederivation.clear_rule: 4,096,163 midpoint logical bytes minus midpoint.arm uint8 and midpoint.modeled_events uint64 equals 4,096,154 explicitly cleared bytes per closure.
cost_rederivation.interpretation: Full-scan rows are projections, not incremental lower bounds. Clear rows are write-induced lower bounds for the proposed soft-dirty scheduler because a write remains dirty even when it restores the previous bytes.

source_interface_audit.member_access_search: Every byte_mixer_ member access in the bound source occurs in predictor.h or predictor.cpp; construction and NumOutputs are initialization, and runtime calls are Perceive, SetOutputBias, SetInput, ByteUpdate, Predict, and reading ex.
source_interface_audit.outbound_value: The only future-affecting component result consumed by Predictor is ByteMixer::Predict()[0], stored in byte_mixer_output and then supplied to the mixer input row on the next Predict call.
source_interface_audit.diagnostic_globals: lstmpr and lstmex each have one declaration and one assignment in predictor.cpp; fxcmv1.cpp declares them extern but contains no value use. They are still retained in the boundary record as a conservative diagnostic.
source_interface_audit.overlay_scope: The v4 integration diff changes makefile and four Lstm/LstmLayer files only; the four added fragments receive no environment pointer/reference.
source_interface_audit.conditional_conclusion: Under identical initialization, input bits, source, and complete boundary-output equality, environment equality follows inductively.
